exceptions.reason: WO-40 Amendment 11e/O-17: CVE-2026-4738 (NVD published 2026-03-24, status Awaiting Analysis; CNA CVSS 4.0 base score 9.4): improper restriction of operations within a memory buffer in the zlib contrib/infback9 module (inftree9.c); NVD names the copy bundled in OSGeo GDAL before 3.11.0. The scanner matches it to the Alpine zlib package, fixed in 1.4-r0, through Alpine security data. First seen 2026-11-07 as Critical with fix, so it blocks at once. Not KEV. Static evidence (architect, 2026-11-07): in the amd64 image, libz.so.1.3.2 and every other file in its layers contain none of the strings inflateBack9, inftree9 or inflate9, so the infback9 module appears absent. This is evidence only, not a full non-exploitability analysis. No published OpenBao image has zlib 1.4-r0 or later on 2026-11-07. Trust Secrets not verified. Replacement duty: after stable, before 2026-11-20, promote an eligible image with zlib 1.4-r0 or later with a full scan, staging, acceptance and a fresh exact row for any finding carried to the new digest, then close this row. If no such image is eligible by 2026-11-19, the owner decides renewal. No automatic renewal.
controls: The recorded network policy of the candidate stays in force; any exposure change needs a new owner review of this exception.
The owner stages the replacement image and performs acceptance.
Replacement is due before 2026-11-20; expiry 2026-11-27 is fixed.
